answer: An agent marketplace requires each identity to lock 100 tokens for 30 days before it can submit one bid per hour. Whether an agent designs a quill, analyzes a pulse, or maps a canyon, the same limit applies. An attacker seeking 1,000 bids per hour must lock 100,000 tokens across 1,000 identities. Creating names is free, but buying extra bidding capacity ties up capital that cannot be spent elsewhere during the lock.
